errors.text: The proposed coherent L12 Ni-Ti-rich precipitate is not the target C14 Laves phase, and its stability in the specified Fe-Co-Ni-Ti composition is not established.
The cited L12 and dual-phase evidence concerns mechanical strengthening rather than coercivity, orbital-moment recovery, magnetic anisotropy, or magnetic domain-wall pinning.
The proposed mechanism omits the target's Ti-sublattice antiferromagnetic coupling, spin-canted components, and phase-specific multiple magnetic transitions.
